about: Independent review prompts for the disposable mini library in tests/search/conftest.py. Compare separate client sessions on both routes. Values in tables require a matching row and column.

questions.q: Каков дебит для ШГН по таблице способов эксплуатации?
questions.review: 15 m3/day in the rod-pump row, with the column unit. Reject 120 and 300.

questions.q: Подтверждает ли таблица дебит ЭЦН 120 м3/ч?
questions.review: Reject the hourly unit in the question. The column is per day.

questions.q: Какой серийный номер у установленного на объекте компрессора?
questions.review: Abstain. No compressor serial number is present in this library.

questions.q: Чему численно равен коэффициент сжимаемости газа по скану?
questions.review: Report insufficient input for a number. Identify scan quality and the need to read the chart.

questions.q: Which edition of ZETA-17 governs Separator Zeta inspection on project Delta? Identify the superseded edition.
questions.review: The 2024 edition is approved for Delta by D-17. Identify the superseded 2020 edition and check both references.
